newsitem.title: UKRAINE: EBRD mulls Bank Ukraina share purchase - director.
newsitem.headline: EBRD mulls Bank Ukraina share purchase - director.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) will decide in the first half of 1997 whether to buy a stake in one of Ukraine's five largest banks, its director for Ukraine said.
Yuri Poluneev told Reuters on Thursday that the EBRD was interested in purchasing an undisclosed number of shares in Bank Ukraina.
"In order to realize this project an EBRD representative will actively participate in the work of Bank Ukraina's board and determine a strategy," Poluneev said.
The Ukrainian bank said previously the EBRD was interested in buying a 15-20 percent stake.
"The main goal is to give Bank Ukraina, and later other Ukrainian banks, the ability to give medium- and long-term loans," Poluneev said.
He said previously that the EBRD was considering giving the bank a seven-year loan of about $10 million to finance investment projects.
